sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: A small species, the head dark brown, the thorax and abdomen a lighter brown, the antennae 13-segmented. Very close to E. mareebensis, from which it differs in the slightly larger head, less strongly constricted, with the dorsum concave in side view; the nasus very slender and narrow, paler in the apical half than in the basal half; the antennal segments longer and paler; and the thorax and abdominal tergites darker. Mandibles without apical teeth. The alate is not recorded in the original.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: A small species, the head dark brown, the thorax and abdomen a lighter brown, the antennae 13-segmented. Very close to E. mareebensis, from which it differs in the slightly larger head, less strongly constricted, with the dorsum concave in side view; the nasus very slender and narrow, paler in the apical half than in the basal half; the antennal segments longer and paler; and the thorax and abdominal tergites darker. Antennal segment 1 long and slender; segment 2 about half of segment 1; segment 3 as long as segment 1, distinctly narrowed at the base; segment 4 slightly shorter than segment 2, the shortest of all; segment 5 shorter than segment 6; segments 6—12 long and narrow; segment 13 shorter than segment 12. Mandibles without apical teeth. Nasus about 3/4 of the rest of the head. Measurements: body length 2.86—3.48 mm; head length (to apex of nasus) 1.39—1.46 mm; head width 0.59—0.62 mm; pronotum width 0.36 mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Upper surface of the head uniformly dark brown, the sutures very distinct; postclypeus, pronotum and abdominal tergites slightly paler. Antennae 15-segmented; segment 3 usually the shortest of all. Postclypeus length slightly more than half its width. Measurements: body length 4.00 mm; head length (to apex of labrum) 1.39 mm; head length (to clypeofrontal suture) 0.80 mm; head width 1.06 mm; pronotum width 0.60 mm.
